about: Merge card or question: the Foreman story view's kindOf and the needs-you set's card_kind both read these cases.

cases.name: a short PR link with a merge reply and send back
cases.text: acme/app#1291 is green and reviewed. Reply `merge` or send back.

cases.name: a full PR link offering merge or send back
cases.text: https://github.com/acme/app/pull/77 passed review. Merge or send back?

cases.name: merge / send back with quotes
cases.text: Reply "merge" to land it, or "send back" with notes.

cases.name: a question with no PR
cases.summary: pins per window or per group?
cases.text: Round 4 of 5 is waiting on one call: pins per window or per group?

cases.name: a PR without an offer to merge
cases.text: acme/app#40 is open. Which reviewer should take it? You can send back notes.

cases.name: an offer to merge with no PR named
a PR and a merge reply but no send back
an issue number is not a PR
